sends one message to a team, re"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"uses `context_id` to continue a remote conversation, and fails over across

| `a2a_tasks` | Which async tasks still owe a receipt? | Three tiers: owed rows k"},{"id":"p16s7","text":"eep the follow-up `context_id`; past-TTL rows auto-dead-letter (still settleable); outcomes land in "},{"id":"p16s8","text":"the bounded archive; persisted across restarts. |
| `a2a_probe` | Is the fleet healthy? | One verifi"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"ed-card fetch per in-scope peer (or one given url); `N reachable, M down`; misses classified `unreac"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"hable` vs `rejected`. |
